notes.title: Concise Development Diary #0
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone![/p][p]I thought it was time to share [b]some news on the development of EMPTY SHELL 2[/b] [b]:)[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Over the past few months, [b]I've been working a lot on the levels, and I'd say I'm roughly at 50% done with the environments[/b]. The interesting part is that, even in its current state, [b]the sequel is already bigger than the first EMPTY SHELL[/b] [b]:)[/b][/p][p][/p][p]But level design for the sequel is [b]more complex[/b] than in the original. [/p][p][b]In the first game, each level was kind of a "standalone" entity[/b]: any key items required to progress, as well as the puzzles that need to be solved, were always tied to the area currently being explored.[/p][p][b]In EMPTY SHELL 2 things are different[/b]: given its extraction nature and the possibility/necessity of freely entering and leaving the various locations, [b]a deep interconnection has formed between different levels[/b].[/p][p]Volunteers may often need to extract from an area in order to find a key item needed to progress, [b]potentially located in a completely different level.[/b] They might need to unlock a path through a remote terminal located in a different building, or retrieve an access badge belonging to a facility administrator, before going back to the level where the badge is actually needed.[/p][p][b]A switch on a control panel in one part of the Facility might open a passage in another building[/b], which volunteers may only visit days later while carrying out a different task on their list.[/p][p][/p][p]At the moment, one of my favorite locations is [b]建物F[/b] (Building F).
Its exact purpose is unknown, but judging from the abandoned equipment it seems to have been [b]some kind of support complex for Building B in the East Wing[/b], where plants necessary for the production of nutrients for the Facility's personnel were studied and cultivated.[/p][p]And it seems that, as eventually happens, [b]those very plants and nature itself reclaimed the entire building[/b], turning it into a tomb overrun by roots and vines of unnatural size.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633273/5483a7da967e6f0b2e874beadc9591551fbcd35e.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Anyway, in these past days, I've paused level design to focus on [b]new enemies[/b]. Personally, spending too much time in a row on a single task can be harmful in terms of originality and variety.[/p][p]For me, it's always useful to throw in new movies, books, or videogames, so I can draw fresh inspiration or make some comparisons before moving forward.[/p][p][/p][p]I'll give you more updates in the coming weeks : )[/p][p]Speak soon, volunteers.[/p]

notes.title: Demo Difficulty resetting bug
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]just fixed an issue in the demo that sometimes was causing the difficulty to reset to "Easy" : )[/p]

notes.title: QoL + (a couple of) Modifiers
notes.content: [p]Hey, everyone![/p][p][/p][p]I realize that some players prefer more action and don’t feel like [b]messing around with terminals and command-based navigation[/b]. I didn’t want to just add a simple option entry, so, something I’ve been meaning to do for a while, I created a new view called "[b]Modifiers[/b]".[/p][p][/p][p]From now on, [b]it’s possible to disable terminals and replace them with a more immediate interface[/b]. I also added a modifier to [b]randomize the starting stats[/b] of each volunteer (HP, armor, stamina, melee damage buff/debuff, and critical chance), for those who feel like testing their luck a bit. :)[/p][p][/p][p]At the moment, there are only these two modifiers, but I’ll be adding more in the future (there will definitely be many in the full version).[/p][p][/p][p]As some of you suggested on Discord, [b]I also switched the wording from "required/owned" to "owned/required"[/b] in the Crafting Stations, which seems to be the standard in most games.[/p][p][/p][p]One last thing: from now on, in most cases, [b]secret rooms will be less obvious to spot[/b]. This way, you’ll need to rely more on the [b]Detector[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Let me know what you think![/p]

notes.title: Just another abomination
notes.content: [p]According to Ainu folklore, [b]Akkorokamui アッコロカムイ is a giant monster with a tentacled form[/b], said to dwell in Uchiura Bay on the island of Hokkaido.[/p][p]But what lurks beneath the pier of the island's old harbor is [b]merely another of the abominations created by the Entity[/b].[/p][p][/p][h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633273/1f3f8b36db5183249e65df24324971f63a4d316d.gif"][/img][/h1]

notes.title: Maintenance Tunnels
notes.content: [p]While most areas will be accessible via the rail transport system or by sea using a boat, some zones won't be directly connected to the hideout and will require passage through the [b]Maintenance Tunnels[/b] to reach them.[/p][p]These tunnels will sometimes be lit by emergency lights, while at other times [b]they may be completely shrouded in darkness[/b].[/p][p]Additionally, [b]since the areas reached through the maintenance tunnels are more remote, they won't have extraction zones[/b]. To return to the hideout, you'll need to go back through the tunnels.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45633273/af9878e121a67106310e7b2b475417d7f298eeba.gif"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Stash fix
notes.content: [p]Hey, everyone![/p][p][/p][p]Quick update that fixes a couple of issues with the [b]Stash[/b]:[/p][p][/p][list][*][p]fixed an issue where gadgets were showing the the label "equipped" in the Stash[/p][/*][*][p]fixed a problem that was preventing Crafting Materials to properly stack when transfering from Inventory to Stash[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Alternative ammo
notes.content: [p]Hey, everyone![/p][p]I'm reading this book about WW1, and I discovered that [b]explosive bullets[/b] were actually used during the conflict. Pretty scary stuff.[/p][p]But then it gave me an idea: [b]what if there were "special" types of ammo in ES2 you could swap to[/b], at least for some weapons?[/p][p]Would you like that?[/p]

notes.title: Inventory categories and more
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone![/p][p][/p][p]Today's update introduces some useful QoL features that help make things a bit clearer.[/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Inventory and Stash items are now organized[/b] into the following groups: [b]Ranged[/b], [b]Melee[/b], [b]Consumables[/b], [b]Gadgets[/b], [b]Crafting Materials[/b], and [b]Misc[/b], to keep everything tidy.[/p][/*][*][p]When trying to add an item to your inventory, [b]the "Weight limit reached" message now also shows by how much you're exceeding the limit[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Shared Logger entries can now be collapsed/expanded[/b]. This will be especially useful in the full version, where there will be many more entries.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]flashlight[/b] is still a mandatory, non-droppable item, but [b]its weight has been reduced from 0.52 kg / 1.14 lb to 0.128 kg / 0.282 lb[/b]. I'll probably revisit this later to improve it and treat it like a "normal" item.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Flashlight batteries are lighter too[/b]: their weight has been reduced [b]from 0.16 kg / 0.35 lb to 0.08 kg / 0.17 lb[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue that sometimes caused [b]ammo counts to go negative[/b] when dropping ammo while having a weapon equipped and using it.[/p][/*][/list][p]
[b]Let me know how it feels with the update![/b][/p]

notes.title: Thanks! And work in progress
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

Thanks for playing the demo of EMPTY SHELL 2, I hope you're enjoying it so far!
Also, a big thank you for all the feedback. I'm working hard to fix issues and make improvements, and [b]your input is incredibly helpful to shape the game in the best possible way :)[/b]

Right now, I'm working on [b]dividing the inventory and the stash into categories[/b], to make everything clearer!
As you've probably noticed, in EMPTY SHELL 2 there's a lot of loot to deal with (even more than in the first EMPTY SHELL), and a feature like this is essential, [b]especially in the full game[/b].

Also, [b]I'm redoing the flashlight to treat it like every other item[/b], so you can actually drop it to free up some space if you don't want to carry it around.

I'll let you know when it's done!

notes.title: Small fix for weapon mods
notes.content:
Hey, everyone,

just fixed the issue where a weapon could be modded [b]with the same mod already installed[/b] consuming crafting materials :(

notes.title: A quick one
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!

A small update with a QoL feature many of you have asked for, plus a few other fixes:

[list]
[*] Added a "[b]Typing effect[/b]" option to [b]enable (default) or disable the typing effect[/b] pretty much everywhere (excluding the intro and end message) so that you can instantly see descriptions, lore content etc skipping the typing text (i'm gonna bring this one in the first EMPTY SHELL soon)
[*] Updated the [b]description of an item[/b] to give a little hint on how to complete the task
[*] Fixed a bug that [b]allowed to exceed the health, armor, or stamina cap[/b] when looting a dead body
[/list]

That's it for this update :)

notes.title: Some rebalancing
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

this update brings some [b]rebalancing[/b], specifically:

[list]
[*] health cap [b]250[/b]
[*] protections cap [b]250[/b]
[*] stamina cap [b]200%
[/b][*] [b]disabled the spawn of a certain enemy in the first location on first visit[/b], to prevent unfair difficulty due to lack of equipment
[*] [b]protections upgrade[/b] can now appear in the Upgrade Stations
[*] fixed the [b]hitbox of the dogs[/b] (the head couldn't be hit)
[*] better hint for a specific puzzle/interaction
[/list]

Let me know how it goes!

notes.title: A second update
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!

Here's another update, this time a little bit more substantial:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where [b]melee attacks were sometimes triggering twice[/b]
[*] [b]Crafting materials are now shared between the Stash and the Inventory while in the Hideout[/b], so the volunteer no longer needs to walk back and forth between the Stash and the Crafting Station
[*] [b]N60 rebalancing[/b]: damage (it scales with difficulty) increased from 55 to 66, reload time 2.9s->3.25s (buffed)
[*] [b]Micro Missiles rebalancing[/b]: damage (it scales with difficulty) decreased from 150 to 130, cooldown time 60s->90s (nerfed)
[*] [b]Neural Shield[/b]: radius increased from 16m to 25m (buffed), new sfx
[*] Fixed an issue where enemies hit at point-blank range by Micro Missiles would get an [b]absurdly long health bar :|[/b]
[*] Fixed an issue with [b]devices that sometimes were staying active after an extraction[/b]
[*] Fixed an issue that caused [b]more than one Medikit to be consumed when crafting Adrenaline[/b]
[*] Fixed an issue that was causing the [b]volunteer to freeze if dodging while extracting[/b]
[*] Fixed a bug that was causing some upgrades to ignore the [b]cooldown after a purchase[/b]. Now you'll notice that, for example, if you buy health++, you won't find it in the same area for some time (~30 minutes, but [b]cooldowns reset if you die[/b])
[*] Small typo (this->these)
[/list]

That's it for now!
[b]Thanks for all the feedback so far![/b]

notes.title: First small update
notes.content:
Hey, everyone!

Quick update, mostly QoL. Here's the changelog:

[list]
[*] [b]Enemies activates when taking damage[/b]: sometimes it happened that an enemy couldn’t see the player, but the player was still able to hit them while remaining hidden
[*] Fixed some UIs when playing with a [b]16:10 resolution[/b]
[*] [b]Item weight is now visible in multiple views[/b] (stash, crafting stations, upgrades stations, drop/transfer dialog)
[*] The message "inventory full" was a little misleading, now it says "[b]weight limit reached[/b]"
[*] Fixed the description for the [b]"Firefighter" achievement[/b]
[*] Fixed a bug that occurred when transferring crafting materials
[/list]

That's it, for now!
